possible_explanations.statement: Tasmania was exporting (net flow out) 382.68 MW at 2026-07-31 07:30 AEST (2026-07-30T21:30:00Z) (ev0432); that export might be associated with higher local RRP.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain DISPATCHINTERCONNECTORRES rows and interconnector marginal values for Basslink for the interval ending 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z to see if export limits or local price adjustments were binding, and check interconnector marginal contribution to price.

possible_explanations.statement: Local dispatch TOTALDEMAND was 1472.42 MW at 2026-07-31 07:30 AEST (2026-07-30T21:30:00Z) (ev0431) and operational demand for the half‑hour was 1402.0 MW (ev0893); an imbalance between demand and available local generation might be associated with the high RRP.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check unit availability, rebid logs and unit outage/return records around 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z to see if large units were unavailable or offers were withdrawn.

possible_explanations.statement: Large changes in generator SCADA readings in the 18:30–22:30 UTC window (e.g. GORDON +219.19 MW ev0920, TVCCPS +82.38 MW ev0923, CETHANA +59.16 MW ev0926) might be related to dispatch responses or unit availability and could be associated with price movements.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Review rebid logs and unit outage/return records for the specific units (GORDON, TVCCPS, CETHANA) at the times of their SCADA changes to determine whether changes were bidding/availability actions or normal dispatch ramping.

possible_explanations.statement: Basslink-specific NEMDE modelling behaviours (two NEMDE runs selecting frequency controller status, no-go zone and FCAS transfer capability) are documented in AEMO procedures (aemo_so_op_3705) and might have affected the dispatch solution and prices.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain NEMDE run diagnostics and the SOMMS/Basslink frequency controller input status for the trading interval ending 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z to see if the second run selection or Basslink frequency controller status changed the dispatch solution.

possible_explanations.statement: FCAS transfer interactions via Basslink (noted in procedures) might have influenced scheduling and prices when Basslink flows exceeded FCAS transfer thresholds.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check FCAS enablement records and DISPATCHINTERCONNECTORRES FCASEXPORTLIMIT/FCA SIMPORTLIMIT for Basslink at 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z and review FCAS price/dispatch for the interval.
